Subject: CloudSight renewal proposal - SnowDB + LookDeck (expires 2027-01-15)

Hi Marcus + Lauren,

Thanks for the partnership this year — quick note to share our renewal proposal for the SnowDB compute credits and LookDeck support contract. Key points: 
- 12-month renewal starting 2027-01-15
- SnowDB credits: 1.2M credits / year (same consumption band)
- LookDeck support: Premium (24/7) with 8 support seats
- Proposed list price increase ~6% vs current (we've applied a 10% loyalty credit to net terms)

I've attached the quote (CloudSight_Renewal_Quote_2027.pdf). Would you be open to a quick 30-min sync next week to walk through usage and any pricing questions? If helpful I can share an options sheet (multi-year vs committed credits).

Thanks,
Sara Jones\Account Executive, CloudSight

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: CloudSight renewal proposal - SnowDB + LookDeck (expires 2027-01-15)

Looping you both in — Sara sent the renewal quote this morning. Quick asks: 
- Lauren: can you confirm actual SnowDB consumption last 12 months and projected Q1/Q2 2027? Ideally a short CSV export.
- Neha: any known contract clauses we should flag (data residency, SOC2 appendix)?
- Markus: finance, are we ok with the proposed billing cadence? Also, is a multi-year commit worth negotiating for a better rate?

If the numbers look similar to prior, I want to push for a lower CPI and a cap on overage rates. Otherwise, we should consider re-opening RFP vs DataForge (they surfaced last quarter).

Thanks — let me know if I should schedule a vendor call (I can do 12/08 morning).

Subject: Re: CloudSight renewal proposal - SnowDB + LookDeck (expires 2027-01-15)

Attached an export and the signed SOW from 2024. Quick notes after a first pass:
- usage_snapshot_Q4_2026.csv shows 1.05M credits consumed last 12 months (seasonal Q4 spike) — CloudSight's proposed 1.2M is reasonable as a buffer, but we can remove 10% headroom if we commit to autoscaling policies.
- current SLA for LookDeck is standard (business hours); upgrading to Premium yields faster response but we rarely use 24/7. Recommend negotiating Premium for 4 seats instead of 8.
- suggested negotiation points: remove auto-renew clause, cap overage per-credit at +15% year-over-year, include a clause for rollback to prior tier if usage decreases >20%.

If we want to explore alternatives I pinged Kate at DataForge for an informal pricing comparison (no RFP yet) — she may share a ballpark.

Attachments: usage_snapshot_Q4_2026.csv (csv, 48KB); CloudSight_SOW_2024_signed.pdf (pdf, 210KB)

—Lauren
Product Operations Manager

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Jones <sara.jones@cloudsight.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-07T15:32:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CloudSight renewal proposal - SnowDB + LookDeck (expires 2027-01-15)

Sara — thanks for the quote. We've reviewed internally and have a few negotiation asks before we sign: 
- Reduce proposed price increase to <=2% (we value the partnership but need predictable unit economics)
- Reduce LookDeck Premium seat count to 4 and move to seat-based add-ons (we'll preserve 24/7 for incident-critical paths)
- Remove auto-renew and add a 60-day cancellation window for material SLA regressions
- Provide a committed-credit discount tier if we sign 24 months (please show 12-mo vs 24-mo pricing in a short options table)

We're available for a 30-min call on 2026-12-08 between 9:00-11:30 PT. I'll bring finance and product. I've attached our redlines to speed the loop (Redwood_Renewal_Redlines_20261207.pdf).

Looking forward — Marcus
VP, Platform Engineering
